description.zh-CN: AWS S3 可留空；MinIO、R2 等填写完整 HTTPS 地址。
description.en-US: Leave empty for AWS S3; enter the full HTTPS URL for MinIO, R2, or another compatible service.

description.zh-CN: 服务商要求的区域；R2 通常使用 auto。
description.en-US: Provider region; Cloudflare R2 commonly uses auto.

description.zh-CN: 用于保存附件的 Bucket 名称。
description.en-US: Bucket used to store attachment objects.

description.zh-CN: 留空时使用 AWS 默认凭据链。
description.en-US: Leave empty to use the AWS default credential chain.

description.zh-CN: MinIO 等自建服务通常需要开启。
description.en-US: Commonly required by self-hosted MinIO endpoints.

description.zh-CN: 可选 CDN 或公开 Bucket 地址；留空时公开附件仍走 Host 代理。
description.en-US: Optional CDN or public bucket URL; leave empty to use the Host content proxy.
